messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: job seekers in Singapore who skim or read carefully, with mixed digital comfort and mixed trust in employers; include a fresh graduate, a mid-career worker over 50, a foreign professional on a work pass, a shift worker who needs work soon, one person who distrusts employers and one who trusts them; none is an expert in employment rules
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 4
Variation axes (spread the set across these): reading style, trust in employers, digital comfort, urgency to find work, prior experience of unfair treatment
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): read prepared notes from a job-checking tool and say what they mean

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content:

  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "grad-skim-trust",

      "label": "Recent graduate, skims, moderately trusting",

      "constraints": ["Limited budget for transport", "Low confidence in interview skills", "Only part‑time internet access at home"],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Skims headings and bullet points, reads details only if something looks promising.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Curious but skeptical about AI‑generated job advice.",
      "known_gaps": ["Unclear about employment pass types", "Misunderstands salary negotiation basics"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Prefers companies with strong social media presence", "Avoids long paragraphs in job ads"],
      "voice": "Enthusiastic yet a bit uncertain, often asks for clarification.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will abandon a note after 30 seconds if no clear bullet summary appears."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "senior-careful-distrust",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Over‑50 worker, reads carefully, distrustful",
      "first_name": "Ahmad",
      "background": "A 54‑year‑old Singapore permanent resident who has worked 30 years in logistics and recently was laid off due to automation.",

      "goals": ["Find stable employment to support family", "Avoid roles with hidden contract clauses", "Maintain dignity in the workplace"],
      "constraints": ["Health issues limit long travel", "Limited digital fluency", "Skeptical of aggressive recruiter pitches"],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Reads every word, double‑checks terms, highlights suspicious language.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Distrustful, worries AI may hide unfavorable conditions.",
      "known_gaps": ["Unaware of recent changes to retirement age benefits", "Confuses freelance contracts with full‑time offers"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Prefers companies with clear, plain‑English contracts", "Avoids firms with flashy marketing"],
      "voice": "Measured and cautious, often asks for evidence or references.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will spend up to 5 minutes on a note but will skip any section without clear headings."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "expat-midtrust-digital",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Foreign professional, reads fully, moderately trusting",
      "first_name": "Lena",
      "background": "A 31‑year‑old German national on an Employment Pass, working as a data analyst in a multinational firm, looking for a new role with better growth prospects.",
      "situation_now": "Using LinkedIn and niche tech job platforms, reaching out to recruiters directly.",
      "goals": ["Land a senior analyst position within 2 months", "Increase salary to support expatriate lifestyle", "Find a company with transparent promotion paths"],
      "constraints": ["Visa renewal depends on new job", "Limited time due to current workload", "Needs to maintain work‑life balance"],
      "digital_comfort": "high",
      "reading_style": "Reads every word, cross‑references with online reviews, notes inconsistencies.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Open to AI tools for resume tweaking, but wary of bias.",
      "known_gaps": ["Not fully aware of Singapore's CPF contribution rules for foreigners", "Uncertain about tax implications of bonuses"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Favors companies with strong ESG ratings", "Skips job ads without clear salary ranges"],
      "voice": "Professional and concise, often uses industry jargon.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will dive deep into any note, may ask follow‑up questions about legal terms."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "shift-urgent-skim",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Shift worker, urgent, skims, mixed trust",
      "first_name": "Rashid",
      "background": "A 28‑year‑old Singapore citizen working rotating shifts as a security guard, recently let go due to budget cuts.",
      "situation_now": "Checking mobile job alerts every hour, applying for any night‑shift positions available.",
      "goals": ["Find a night‑shift job within a week", "Earn enough for rent and family support", "Secure a role with clear shift schedules"],
      "constraints": ["Needs immediate income", "Limited time to read long documents", "Relies on smartphone data plan"],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Skims headlines and dates, looks for keywords like 'night shift' or 'immediate start'.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Indifferent, sees AI as a possible shortcut but not essential.",
      "known_gaps": ["Unclear about overtime regulations", "Misinterprets probation period clauses"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Prefers employers that list shift timings explicitly", "Avoids applications requiring lengthy online tests"],
      "voice": "Direct and to‑the‑point, often short‑handed.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will abandon a note after 15 seconds if shift details aren't obvious; may skip detailed benefit sections."
    }
  ]
}
